thread:
alex: seeing apiserver 503 spike in eu-central1 around 09:12 UTC. Lots of watcher reconnects. Anyone else?

maria: seeing it too. controller-manager restarting a couple times.

kevin: logs show etcd write latency jump. WAL fsync 50-200ms -> backlog. paste logs:
```
2026-03-20T09:11:54Z etcdserver: apply entries took too long (ms) 152
2026-03-20T09:11:55Z etcdserver: wal fsync took too long (ms) 187
2026-03-20T09:12:01Z etcdserver: committed entry index 102345
```

jamie: gpu node attach events also spiking in that region, kubelet events flood watchers when pods rebind GPUs — seen this pattern before.

alex: can we confirm NAT/egress or node NIC errors? I/O or network?

sre-bot: alert: apiserver_5xx_rate > 10% for 3m (eu-central1)

maria: checked node metrics: kernel tx_errors on primary NAT gateway, 3 nodes showing drops around the same window.

kevin: controller-manager logs show 'failed to update lease' and aggressive retry backoff causing leader churn. snippet:
```
E0320 09:12:05.123456 1 leaderelection.go:345] error retrieving resource lock: etcdserver: request timed out
```

jamie: quick mitigation options: 1) route controlplane traffic to eu-west fallback (fast but cross-region cost), 2) throttle kubelet attach retries and pause noisy batch jobs (cheaper), 3) short-term iops bump on etcd disks.

alex: prefer cheaper mitigations first. who's able to pause the ML batch rollout?

maria: pausing rollout now — scaling down the GPU job in prod-ml, reducing attach/rebind churn.

kevin: ops, can we request a short iops boost on etcd volumes while we stabilize? WAL latency is killing apply throughput.

oncall: requesting iops bump to 10k IOPS on etcd-disk-euc1 (ticket sent to storage). Also initiating leader re-election just in case.

sre-bot: etcd_iops_change_request: submitted (SR-4521)

jamie: after rollback of the noisy job we still see some watcher reconnects but 5xxs dropped from 12% -> ~3% in the last 3m.

alex: nice. keep monitoring. If WAL fsyncs persist we should consider moving leader to disk with lower contention or increasing commit timeout.

maria: capturing metrics and will add to the incident ticket with histograms for apply latency and watcher reconnect rates. Also collecting kubelet event bursts for correlation.

kevin: temporary config change suggestion: reduce controller-manager lease renew interval from 15s to 30s? That might reduce churn but increases election latency — tradeoff. I can test in staging.

oncall: leader re-election completed at 09:18 UTC, leader moved to node-ctl-03 (healthier NIC). 5xx rate trending down.

alex: follow-ups: (1) ticket to investigate GPU-attach->watch-fanout pattern and add rate-limits in kubelet, (2) storage to evaluate disk type migration for etcd WAL, (3) run controller-manager lease param experiment in staging. I'll open tasks.

maria: adding cost estimate: short-term iops bump vs cross-region failover. iops bump ~ $600/day, cross-region shift ~$4k+ immediate egress. recommending iops bump.

kevin: I'll draft incident postmortem with timeline and mitigation steps. If we see recurrence we'll escalate to region failover.

jamie: monitoring note: set a watcher_reconnect_alert at 1% baseline for eu-central1 to catch earlier next time.

oncall: incident created INC-2442 — https://redwood.example/incidents/INC-2442

alex: thanks team. leaving monitors on 5m cadence and will follow up in the incident thread. :thumbsup:
